name.en: KIMST Marine & Fisheries Startup Investment (O-Startup / Blue Food Tech Fund)

strategy.thesis: Korea's public marine & fisheries venture investment vehicle under the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, administered by KIMST. Forms aquaculture funds (since 2010) plus a dedicated Blue Food Tech Fund for seafood-industry innovation (alt-seafood, 3D printing, aquaculture tech) and an aquaculture secondary fund; supports marine/aquaculture startups through Blue Startup programs and the O-Startup investment system.

summary.en: KIMST (Korea Institute of Marine Science & Technology Promotion), under the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, runs Korea's public marine/fisheries venture investment. It has formed 18 aquaculture funds (≈2.6T won through 2023), a 20B won Blue Food Tech Fund (alt-seafood, 3D printing, aquaculture tech) and a 15B won aquaculture secondary fund, plus the O-Startup investment system and Blue Startup programs.

summary.en: Corporate VC of South Korea's Lotte Group (founded 2016, formerly Lotte Accelerator). It runs the 'Mirae Sikdan' (미래식단) foodtech open-innovation program with the Korea Agriculture Technology Promotion Agency and shared-kitchen operator Wecook, providing selected foodtech startups up to ₩100M plus PoC with Lotte food affiliates, and it participates in the AFPRO agri-food tech expo. It manages 9 funds totaling ₩1,549억.

strategy.thesis: Corporate foodtech open-innovation program of CJ CheilJedang (CJ제일제당), investing in and co-developing with agrifood startups in food-linked AI/robotics, next-gen K-food, alternative foods/sustainable materials, smart manufacturing and food ESG/climate tech.

perks: PoC with CJ CheilJedang business divisions
program.eligibility: Agrifood / foodtech startups whose technology can collaborate with CJ CheilJedang

application.how_to_apply: Apply to the Frontier Labs cohort call (run by CJ CheilJedang's Venture Investment team, with CJ Investment reviewing follow-on capital).

summary.en: Corporate foodtech open-innovation program launched by CJ CheilJedang (CJ제일제당) in 2021. It invests up to ₩300M per startup, offers PoC with CJ's food divisions, and is backed by a 15-member 'Frontier Labs Alliance' (including the Korea Agriculture Technology Promotion Agency and CJ Investment). Over five cohorts (2021–2025) it has collaborated with 19 startups across food AI/robotics, next-gen K-food, alternative foods and food ESG; the 6th cohort recruited into 2026.
summary.local: CJ제일제당이 2021년 출범한 푸드테크 오픈이노베이션 프로그램. 선정 기업에 최대 3억원을 투자하고 CJ 식품 사업부와의 PoC를 제공하며, 한국농업기술진흥원·CJ인베스트먼트 등 15개 기관으로 구성된 '프론티어랩스 얼라이언스'가 지원한다. 5년간 5기에 걸쳐 19개 스타트업과 협업했으며, 식품 연계 AI·로봇, 차세대 K-푸드, 대체식품·지속가능소재, 식품 ESG 등을 다룬다. 6기는 2026년까지 모집했다.
